title: In conversation with Jennifer Collinger
abstract: As part of our special issue on neurotechnology, we spoke with Jennifer Collinger, Professor at the University of Pittsburgh, about how sensory feedback is reshaping brain–computer interfaces, the surprising stability of neural representations after spinal cord injury, and the scientific and engineering challenges of building truly bidirectional neuroprosthetic systems that restore movement and touch.
abstract_zh: 作为我们神经技术专题的一部分，我们与匹兹堡大学的Jennifer Collinger教授交谈，讨论感觉反馈如何重塑脑机接口，脊髓损伤后神经表征的意外稳定性，以及构建真正双向神经假体系统以恢复运动和触觉的科学与工程挑战。
